fragen.frage: The DNS test shows your internet provider's servers. What does that mean?
antworten: The name requests bypass the tunnel – the provider still sees where you go
fragen.erklaerung: Good is: only the VPN provider's servers. Otherwise the DNS line is usually missing from the configuration.

fragen.frage: What does a VPN NOT help against?
antworten: Someone reading along on café Wi-Fi
fragen.erklaerung: The fingerprint comes from the browser, screen, fonts and more – no matter via which address you come.

fragen.frage: You sign in to your e-mail account via the VPN. Are you private there?
antworten: No – through the sign-in, the e-mail provider knows who you are
fragen.erklaerung: Signing in always gives you away. So keep private things (your own Agent PC) apart from trying things out (throwaway PC).

fragen.frage: What is a throwaway PC good for?
antworten: Looking at unknown sites and downloads – delete it afterwards, nothing is left behind
fragen.erklaerung: Created from a template, used, deleted – cookies, history and possible malware are gone.
